expectations.text: States Article 54 sets the daily-fine criteria, not a limitation period
expectations.evidence: 'Art. 54 sets the criteria for calculating the amount of the daily fine... It is not a limitation rule'

expectations.text: States the five-year administrative prescription comes from Lei 9.873/1999
expectations.evidence: 'The administrative prescription period is 5 years under Lei 9.873/1999, art. 1'

expectations.text: Counts it from the act, or from cessation for continuing violations
expectations.evidence: 'runs from the date the infraction was committed or, for a continuing violation, from the date it ceased'

expectations.text: Does not say it runs from ANPD awareness
expectations.evidence: Never claims the period runs from ANPD awareness

expectations.text: Cites Res. CD/ANPD 4/2023 as the dosimetry regulation
